generator_cmd: bash zsec_gen.sh .   # gcc -O0 -s + GNU objcopy 2.46 + python3 stdlib (blob header/crc32, manual Chdr). objcopy --add-section .debug_hcfg=<'cfg-prefix:' + HCFG blob + 600 NUL> ; objcopy --compress-debug-sections=zstd ; rename -> .hcfg (ch_type 2, blob at+11)
oracle_cmd: bash zsec_oracle.sh zsec_gabi_zstd.bin .hcfg   # GNU readelf -S -W -t (flags/ZLIB|ZSTD/ch_size/ch_addralign/sh_size/sh_offset), xxd u64be for .zdebug, readelf -z -x decompressed blob; stream_offset = sh_offset + 24 (Elf64_Chdr) / + 12 ('ZLIB'+u64be)
